# gramlot-examples 0.3.45

- Requires gramlot 0.3.37 (data and structure by address only). gramlot-examples 0.3.44 does not run its gallery with gramlot 0.3.37.
- The gallery passes the Data path of its index state to `mountIndexPage` and reads the index context where the core keeps it; a failed lesson shows its retry message again.
- The gallery bundle gives the inspector the TYTX functions of the page runtime; the frame inspector serves live Data copies through the named connection.
- Lessons follow the core: tree checks come from the `checkedPaths` list, the choice caption is `_dv_displayedValue`, the removed Vizabi trial is no longer mentioned.
